title: Insert Greatest Common Divisors in Linked List
description:
Given the head of a linked list head , in which each node contains an integer value. 
 
 Between every pair of adjacent nodes, insert a new node with a value equal to the greatest common divisor of them. 
 
 Return the linked list after insertion . 
 
 The greatest common divisor of two numbers is the largest positive integer that evenly divides both numbers. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2023/07/18/ex1_copy.png] 
 

 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2023/07/18/ex2_copy1.png]

```
 The 1

There are no pairs of adjacent nodes, so we return the initial linked list.
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 5000] . 
 
 1 <= Node.val <= 1000
code: class Solution {int gcd(int a,int b){while(b){int t=a%b;a=b;b=t;}return a;}public:ListNode* insertGreatestCommonDivisors(ListNode* head){for(ListNode* p=head;p&&p->next;){ListNode* q=p->next;p->next=new ListNode(gcd(p->val,q->val),q);p=q;}return head;}};
